notes.title: Achievment Bug Fix
notes.notes:
We've updated the game to fix a bug with one of the achievements. In recent builds, the President Achievement (100%ing all levels) was not registering. This should be fixed now!

Anyone who should have got the achievement previously but didn't, you should be able to get the achievement by selecting your save file that 100% all levels or by beating a level with that save file. 

If you ever have any issues with this or any other bugs in the game, please let us know! Thank you for your support all these years!

notes.title: Over My Dead Body (For You) Graphical Update
notes.notes: Today marks the third anniversary of the release of Over My Dead Body (For You). Over the past few months, we have been hard at work upgrading some of the levels, improving the layout of decorations, and fixing various blemishes. Today, we have launched a new version of the game with those upgrades. Check it out!

notes.title: Trading Cards
notes.notes: Good news, Everybody! We now have trading cards! Also, to celebrate we're putting the game at 50% for the next few days. Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Summer Sale
notes.notes:
50% off! It's been a year since we first launched on Steam in Early Access. To celebrate our first year and the wonderful 2018 summer, we're slicing the price of OMDB in half! 


Thank you all for your continued support. You are the reason we do this!

notes.title: Boxing Day Update!
notes.notes:
Happy Boxing Day everyone! To celebrate the holiday season, we've put Over My Dead Body (For You) on sale for 25%. 

We've also updated the game, fixing numerous bugs. Issues fixed include bugs with drowning, bugs that caused the game to be unbeatable occasionally in level 4-3, and also a bug that was preventing users from killing all guards in 4-4. That means that all challenges are now unlockable! Can you beat them all?


Thanks for the wonderful launch. 2017 has been a great year for OMDB, and we hope the good times continue into 2018.

notes.title: Control your ghost and zombie in Over My Dead Body
notes.notes:
“Where do I see myself in thirty years?” the interviewer asks. Well, either as a ghost haunting a lonely cove or as part of the happy scrappy skeletal horde rampaging through Armageddon. I do not receive callbacks.

When scientist Noelle Brody got a job at Mortiga Consolidated, she did not expect she’d suffer ‘double undeath’ and be split into both a ghost and a zombie. Yet here she is in Over My Dead Body (For You) [official site], directing both her ethereal and meat aspects around the offices as she solves puzzles, possesses people, devours folks, and runs from robots. After three months in early access, the full game is now out. (more…)

notes.title: Game Release!
notes.notes:
Today we release "Over My Dead Body (For You)"!!! It's been 3 years since the 5 of us started working on this game, and we want to thank you all for the wonderful support we received since we launched that first prototype.


To our Early Access backers: Thank you so much! We hope you will enjoy the final game. Since the last update, we've added the final two levels as well as improved things around the whole game including cleaning up the Challenge Mode.


We hope you enjoy the game! 

Pleasant futures!
